brand_identity.vibe: Cinematic, slow-paced, architectural, calm, futuristic, monumental, environmentally immersive.

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter font-light leading-none
scale.body: text-base md:text-lg leading-relaxed text-foreground/80 font-light tracking-wide

layout_and_spacing.grid_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 md:gap-12 lg:gap-16

motion_philosophy.scroll: Use lenis for buttery smooth momentum scrolling. The website should feel heavy and premium.
motion_philosophy.transitions: Slow, architectural. No bouncy effects. Use ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1].
motion_philosophy.reveal: Framer Motion: initial { opacity: 0, y: 40 }, animate { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, transition { duration: 1.2, ease: 'easeOut' }. Stagger children by 0.2s.
motion_philosophy.hover: Subtle image scale (1.05) over 1.5s, text color shift to primary. No sudden or harsh jumps.

header.style: Fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 py-4. Floating glassmorphism on scroll.
header.layout: Flex container, Brand on left (Cormorant Garamond), Navigation in center (Outfit, hidden on mobile), CTA on right.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary_foreground rounded-none px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-widest text-sm hover:bg-accent_ivory transition-colors duration-500
buttons.outline: border border-primary text-primary rounded-none px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-widest text-sm hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary_foreground transition-colors duration-500

forms.style: Minimalist, editorial. Do not use generic boxed inputs.
forms.inputs: bg-transparent border-0 border-b border-surface_border rounded-none px-0 py-4 text-foreground focus:ring-0 focus:border-primary transition-colors

blueprint_sections.name: Hero Section
blueprint_sections.description: Cinematic full-screen entrance. Golden Palm City entrance gate at sunset.
blueprint_sections.layout: h-screen relative flex items-center justify-center. Image covers background with bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0f0d0c] to-[#0f0d0c]/40 overlay.
elements: H1: 'Escape the chaos. Discover tomorrow early.'

blueprint_sections.name: Discovery Narrative
blueprint_sections.description: Act 2: Minimalist textual interlude. Large editorial typography establishing emotion.
blueprint_sections.layout: Center-aligned, massive padding, max-w-4xl mx-auto text-center.
elements: H2: 'A visionary luxury ecosystem discovered before the rest of the world arrives.'
Floating environmental imagery overlapping the text slightly (use trust_layer_bg or environmental_luxury as accent).

blueprint_sections.name: Environmental & Lifestyle Luxury
blueprint_sections.description: Act 3: Bento layout showcasing the future lifestyle.
elements: Small Image/Text block (col-span-4): Lifestyle Cinematics image. High margin-top to break grid alignment.

blueprint_sections.name: Upcoming Projects
blueprint_sections.description: Act 4: 4 luxury project cards (Golden Palm City, Vantage Farms, Chandan Valley, Doctor's Colony).
elements: Project Cards: Surface cards, 1px subtle border, large edge-to-edge images, minimal elegant text underneath. Image wrappers must have overflow-hidden for scale hover effect.

blueprint_sections.name: Trust Layer & Concierge
blueprint_sections.description: Act 5: Final conversion and trust marks.
elements: Left Side (Trust): RERA & HMDA approvals, connectivity, infrastructure facts.
Right Side (Concierge): Minimalist form (name, phone, interest) using custom bottom-border input styles.

hero_background.description: Golden Palm City entrance gate at golden hour

project_1.description: Golden Palm City luxury & nature villas

environmental_luxury.description: Cinematic architectural photography of palm-lined boulevards and tranquil water reflections

lifestyle_cinematic.description: Modern luxury villa interior looking out towards a calm reflective water pool

trust_layer_bg.description: Abstract macro photography of dune sand textures and monumental beige ivory stone intersecting

components_to_use: Use Shadcn form elements (Input, Button) for the Trust Layer Concierge CTA, but customize styles heavily to match editorial look.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for layouts and sections to maintain organic structure.
technical_instructions.testing_attributes: Add data-testid to ALL interactive and key elements. Role-based, kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='concierge-form').
